queries_run: Incyte distribution channel shift OR business model transition 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述 Incyte 產品仍經專業與零售藥局、專業經銷商及批發商（美國）和零售/醫院藥局、經銷商及獨家批發商（美國以外）銷售；文件未見訂閱化、D2C 或平台化的通路轉型描述。
findings.excerpt: These commercialized products are sold to specialty and retail pharmacies, specialty distributors and wholesalers in the United States in addition to retail pharmacies, hospital pharmacies, distributors and an exclusive wholesaler outside of the United States.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋 1 次未見通路結構性轉移的來源；僅見 Q1 2026 簡報提及通路庫存屬正常範圍（未取得原文）。
